title: Natan bar Shila
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He was chief of the butchers in Tzippori in Rabbi's time, as in Chullin 50b and 58b, and testified before Rabbi about two halakhot in Rabbi Natan's name. Hyman reports that Kaftor VaFerach, chapter 14, reads Rabbi Natan bar Shila.

notes.text: The addition of Rabbi to Natan’s name is the reading Hyman attributes to Kaftor VaFerach. The two halakhot are reported before Rabbi in another Rabbi Natan’s name.

Chullin 50b names Rabbi Natan as the source of the ruling. The consulted Chullin 58b paragraph names Natan bar Shila and records his testimony before Rabbi without expressly naming Rabbi Natan as its source. The Kaftor VaFerach title is Hyman’s report.
